title: Invalidate SCHC sessions across Rule-Version compatibility transitions
description: Rust FragmentationPolicy refreshes a same-key-generation peer in place. If a DIO changes compatibility from v3 to incompatible and later back to v3, preserving the policy generation and session arrays can make pre-transition fragmentation handles valid again. Rotate the policy generation and clear active/prepared/tombstone state whenever compatibility changes, while preserving live sessions for ordinary compatible same-generation DIO refreshes.
notes: Fixed compatibility flip handle revival: policy generation advances and all active/prepared/tombstone state is invalidated across incompatible/compatible transitions; stale permits remain invalid. SCHC full suite and clippy pass.
